chunks: Sa'd ibn Sa'd al-Ash'ari narrated from al-Ridha عليه السلام, who said:
I said: "May the muhrim buy the slave girls or sell?" He said: "Yes."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a person in ihram buy or sell slave girls?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning commercial transactions during ihram. It indicates that a muhrim may buy or sell slave girls, showing that such a transaction is not prohibited merely by entering the state of ihram.
